name: mod_info
summary: The running mod's identity and health: version, pipe name, per-method call counts and times, the game members it reaches, and its cost to the game. Read only.

help.text: pipe_name is the local pipe this game listens on (the server's --pipe), telling which game a server reached when two run on one machine. Lists methods 12 and reflection 10 by default; list_limits keeps more. include_counters true adds the counters of the mod's game-side work (the counters topic).
help.keys: mod_id, mod_version, assembly_version, informational_version, pipe_name, methods [{method, calls, errors, total_ms, mean_ms, max_ms}], count, reflection [{member, resolved, optional}], missing_count, runtime {uptime_s, world_epoch, request_budget_ms, frames, memory, job_settles {run, skipped, unchecked}, connections [{client_id, label, served, subscriptions, methods [{method, calls, errors, total_ms}], method_count}], prefab_index, job_holds, print_log, lint_chip_programs, batch_console, profiling, ...}.

methods.text: methods: every method the mod answers, {method, calls, errors, total_ms, mean_ms (null before the first call), max_ms}, counted in memory after the mod loaded; main-thread time per request; errors are replies with ok false. The pipe reply envelope of the mod carries elapsed_ms, the main-thread time of a request; MCP tool results do not carry it, so use mean_ms and max_ms here.

reflection.summary: The game members the mod reaches.
reflection.text: reflection [{member, resolved, optional}]: every game member the mod reaches by name. Optional ones belong to other mods such as Terraforming Reloaded and BlueprintMod. missing_count: required members not found; methods that need one answer game_changed.

connections.summary: Who calls: each open connection's methods and subscriptions.
connections.text: runtime.connections lists each open connection: client_id, client (its key's name), label (the name it gave), transport, protocol, in_flight, served, bytes_sent, subscriptions (held), and methods: its three most-called methods, each {method, calls, errors, total_ms of main-thread time}, with method_count counting every method it called. Counts are kept while the connection is open. runtime.job_settles counts pipe jobs' settles after each piece: run, skipped (the game had nothing queued) and unchecked (run because its queues could not be read).

runtime.summary: What the mod costs the game.
runtime.text: runtime: uptime_s; world_epoch (worlds left after load; leaving one clears IC pauses, job records, print and flight logs); request_budget_ms (main-thread ms per frame for requests, null = unlimited); frames {busy_frames, requests_served, requests_per_frame_mean, requests_per_frame_max, frame_ms, budget_stops, expired}; memory {gc_collections, gc_max_generation, gc_total_memory_bytes, mono_used_bytes, mono_heap_bytes}; methods: the 10 costliest so far (method_count counts all), each {method, calls, errors, main_thread_ms, handler_ms, serialize_ms, queue_wait_ms, reply_bytes}, the last four as {total, mean, max}; profiling, only while the profiling tool is on: {since_s, slow_frame_ms, frame_ms {p50, p95, max}, worst_frame_ms, top [{name, ms}]}, top being the five pieces with the most self time; prefab_index {ready, verify, things, names, verified, differences}: ready, lists filtered by prefab read the prefab index (false: they walk every thing); things and names filed; with [Performance] VerifyPrefabIndex on, verified counts the indexed queries checked against a full walk and differences those that differed (each logged). include_counters adds the game counters (the counters topic).

counters.summary: Counters of the game-side work the mod does.
counters.text: Only with include_counters true. Counted from mod load, profiling on or off. prefab_index.arrived and left: things the game reported spawning and despawning. job_holds {under_100ms, under_1s, under_10s, under_60s, over_60s}: how long jobs held the game tick, one count per hold, each bucket from its lower edge (over_60s: 60 s or more). print_log {records, capacity}: print provenance records held, and the most kept before the oldest drop. lint_chip_programs: chip programs the lint cache holds parsed. batch_console {lines, lines_per_minute}: lines a dedicated server printed, and per minute over the last full minute; 0 on a game with a window.

include_counters.description: Default false; true adds the runtime counters of the mod's game-side work: job_holds, print_log, lint_chip_programs, batch_console, and prefab_index arrived and left.
